# AssetFlow

> AssetFlow Home helps people organize household assets, plan maintenance,
> keep documents and service history together, and collaborate with their household.

The public website is https://myassetsflow.com/. The application is at
https://myassetsflow.app/. Home is the active edition; Business, Hospitality,
and Fleet are coming soon. AI maintenance plans are drafts for people to review.
Connected calendar synchronization is planned; the current calendar workflow
uses an iCalendar (.ics) download. English, Italian, German, Spanish, French,
and Arabic are supported through the website's language selector.

## Product information

- [Product overview](https://myassetsflow.com/index.md): Plain Markdown summary of the public landing page for AI assistants.
- [Landing page](https://myassetsflow.com/): Current public features, edition availability, and pricing.
- [Pricing](https://myassetsflow.com/pricing/en/): Current plan details and allowances; check this page rather than assuming prices.
- [Solutions](https://myassetsflow.com/solutions/en/): Localized comparison of Home, Business, Fleet and Hospitality editions.

## Application and policies

- [AssetFlow Home](https://myassetsflow.app/): Access the application; personal household data requires authentication.
- [Privacy policy](https://myassetsflow.app/privacy): Published privacy information.
- [Terms of service](https://myassetsflow.app/terms): Published terms.
